_comment: Data periods for dashboards the metrics pipeline does not describe.
The five headline dashboards (CPI, GDP, Labour Force, Household Income,
Population) get their period automatically from keyPenangMetrics via the
'Penang at a glance' cards. This file covers dashboards outside that set.
Every value was read from the live Google Sheet the pipeline writes, not
typed from memory. 'source' records where, so the next person can re-check
Every dashboard now carries a date. Five come from keyPenangMetrics; the
rest are listed here. Entries without an 'updated' value are ones no
pipeline run writes: their numbers are maintained by hand, so there is no

health.source: main workbook, tab 'utilisation_opendosm', max(date) = 2025-05-31; the facilities half only reaches 2023

prop.source: all four property sheets, max Date = 2021-03-01 (house_prices only reaches 2019). They were 403 to the pipeline until access was restored 2026-09-30, and no run has written them since, so there is no 'updated' value yet.

manf.source: published CSV behind the dashboard (MIDA), max(Date) = 2026-06-01, same for the Penang rows. Not pipeline-fed, so no 'updated'.

finance.source: published CSVs behind the dashboard, fiscal position max(Year) = 2026 (marked Actual); the revenue-items CSV only reaches 2025. Not pipeline-fed, so no 'updated'.

gender.source: women_stats sheet, tabs Education / Decision-making / stateDM / federalDM all max(Year) = 2024. Output sheet only; its transform still produces nothing, so no 'updated'.

grad.source: graduates output sheet, sektor_ekonomi and status_pekerjaan max(tahun) = 2024 (graduate_status only 2023). Output sheet only; its transform still produces nothing, so no 'updated'.
